source_text: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
child_paraphrase: Give thanks to the Lord, because He is good, and His kindness never ends.
license_note: Short quotation of the 1769 Oxford King James Version. That edition is public domain in the United States. No bulk copyrighted Bible text is used.
